description: This file defines a custom Flask Blueprint class with methods for static file handling, resource opening, and cache control, extending functionality from a sansio blueprint.

classes.name: Blueprint
classes.description: A subclass of SansioBlueprint that adds static file serving, resource opening, and cache control functionalities.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Blueprint with parameters for static files, templates, URL prefix, subdomain, URL defaults, root path, and CLI group.

methods.name: get_send_file_max_age
methods.description: Determines the max age for caching a static file based on app configuration.

methods.name: send_static_file
methods.description: Serves static files from the static folder, raising an error if static folder is not set.

methods.name: open_resource
methods.description: Opens a resource file relative to the blueprint's root path for reading, supporting binary and text modes.
